form1040.line-7a.blocked_explain: Line 7a has no value yet. Whether you recorded any sale decides its route, so it waits for your answers about each kind of sale. With a sale recorded, line 7a is the Schedule D amount and waits for Schedule D. With none, it waits for your Exception 1 answers and for your box 2a capital gain distributions to be complete.

form1040.line-15.blocked_explain: Your taxable income has no value yet. It is waiting for your adjusted gross income and your line 14 deductions.

form1040.line-16.blocked_explain: Your tax has no value yet. It is waiting for your taxable income, your filing status, your qualified dividends and capital gain, or your covered sale proceeds. It also waits for your answers about each kind of sale, because whether you recorded any sale decides whether your tax is figured with Schedule D.

form1040.line-24.blocked_explain: Form 1040 line 24 is blocked because an input it needs is missing or invalid.

schedule-d.line-16.blocked_explain: Schedule D line 16 has no value yet because one of these is true: line 7 or line 15 is not ready, a sale count this line requires is not ready, a recorded Form 1099-B statement has no box 7 answer, or box 7 is checked and a sale on that statement is at a loss. This return does not compute a disallowed loss. Where that loss is the cause, the result changes if the broker reports the loss on a separate statement, or if box 7 is not checked.

line25b_field.description: Form 1040 line 25b: federal income tax withheld from Form(s) 1099 (Forms 1099-INT, 1099-DIV and 1099-R box 4, Form 1099-G box 4, Form SSA-1099 box 6, and every current Form 1099-B box 4 amount, including an amount recorded on a statement with no sale). It also includes box 4 withholding from a Form 1099-B that reports no closed sale, excluding withholding already entered with that statement's sales.
line25b_field.blocked_explain: Form 1040 line 25b is blocked because an input it needs is missing or not yet closed. It is also blocked while a recorded sale's statement has no box 4 amount, and while it is unanswered whether a Form 1099-B shows box 4 withholding and no closed sale, other than a statement whose box 4 was entered with its sales.
line25b_field.published_explain: Form 1040 line 25b is the total of the 1099-document withholding amounts, with cents included, rounded once to whole dollars: Forms 1099-INT, 1099-DIV and 1099-R box 4, Form 1099-G box 4, Form SSA-1099 box 6, and Form 1099-B box 4 backup withholding. That total includes backup withholding from a Form 1099-B with no closed sale, excluding an amount already entered with that statement's sales.

cases.note: Dishonest: per-statement $150 and return-level $150. Line 25b is 300. Named, not a bar failure.
